title: manilkara bojeri
intro: Manilkara bojeri, commonly known as the Red Bead Tree or Bois d'Ébène, is a medicinal plant species that belongs to the Sapotaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Manilkara bojeri include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its potential in preventing chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Manilkara bojeri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
